Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL5604062. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return columns chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
